He plays both the [[power forward]] and [[small forward]] positions. Doumbouya was selected by the [[Detroit Pistons]] with the fifteenth pick in the [[2019 NBA draft]], and in his rookie season, he was the [[List of oldest and youngest National Basketball Association players|youngest active player in the NBA]]. Born in [[Conakry]], [[Guinea]], Doumbouya grew up in [[Paris]], [[France]] and began his career with local club CJF Les Aubrais when he was 13. In the following year, he attended [[INSEP]] and played for amateur team [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball|Centre Fédéral]]. His professional career started in 2016, when he joined [[Poitiers Basket 86]] in the [[LNB Pro B|second-tier league]] of France, remaining with the team for two seasons. In 2018, Doumbouya moved to the first division by signing with [[Limoges CSP]]. Doumbouya was a regular member of the youth sections of the [[France national under-19 basketball team|France national team]]. He helped France win the gold medal at the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], finishing as his team's leading scorer. In 2026, he represented the [[Guinea men's national basketball team|Guinea national team]] in the [[2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification]] matches.https://www.dazn.com/en-CA/news/basketball/which-nba-players-fiba-basketball-world-cup-african-qualifiers-t3r/ew00jcqocngd1u0e3jgmdpmzo ==Early life and career== Doumbouya was born in [[Conakry]], Guinea.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya, 16 ans, enflamme l'Euro U18 avec les Bleus |url=https://www.basketsession.com/actu/sekou-doumbouya-15-ans-enflamme-leuro-u18-bleus-355849/ |publisher=BasketSession |access-date=18 August 2018 |language=fr |date=19 December 2016}} As a one-year-old, he moved to France with his mother M'Mah Marie, three siblings, and one cousin, settling in a small apartment in [[Fleury-les-Aubrais]].{{cite web |last1=Ohnona |first1=Yann |title=Qui est Sekou Doumbouya, la nouvelle pépite du basket-ball français? |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Article/Qui-est-sekou-doumbouya-la-nouvelle-pepite-du-basket-ball-francais/887455 |website=[[L'Équipe]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |language=fr |date=26 March 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Gaibotti |first1=Federico |title=Sekou Doumbouya: scouting report on the '00 French forward |url=https://www.basketuniverso.it/sekou-doumbouya-scouting-report-the-00-french-forward/ |publisher=BasketUniverso |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=26 November 2017}}{{cite web |last1=Meler |first1=Bryan |title=Meet Europe's Next Elite NBA Prospect: France's Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.slamonline.com/international/sekou-doumbouya-feature/ |website=[[Slam (magazine)|Slam]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=28 June 2018}} His father, who was unable to receive a [[travel visa|visa]], remained in Guinea as a member of its [[Military of Guinea|military]].{{cite web |last1=Bancharel |first1=Antoine |title=Sekou Doumbouya : " Ils veulent tous savoir la même chose. Tous " |url=https://basket-infos.com/2019/06/19/grosse-interview-sekou-doumbouya-ils-veulent-tous-savoir-la-meme-chose-tous/ |publisher=Basket Infos |access-date=25 June 2019 |language=fr |date=19 June 2019}} In the absence of his father, Sekou became a leader for the rest of his family, often advising his siblings. Doumbouya grew up playing [[association football|football]] as a [[striker (association football)|striker]] but was eventually hindered by his extraordinary height.{{cite web |last1=Gardner |first1=David |title=17-Year-Old NBA Superprospect Sekou Doumbouya Gets His First Taste of NBA Life |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2761012-17-year-old-nba-superprospect-sekou-doumbouya-gets-his-first-taste-of-nba-life |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=23 February 2018}}{{cite web |title=Doumbouya's delayed international debut has been worth the wait |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/doumbouyas-delayed-international-debut-has-been-worth-the-wait |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=19 December 2016}} At age 12, he began playing [[pick-up game|pick-up]] basketball after a friend introduced him to the sport. At that age, he was discovered by local basketball coach Benoist Burguet, who helped start his basketball career and later became his trainer.{{cite web |last1=Drechsler |first1=Guillaume |last2=Normand |first2=Eric |title=Sekou Doumbouya, la future star du basket français, est revenu à Fleury-les-Aubrais pour les fêtes |url=https://www.francebleu.fr/sports/basket-handball-volley/sekou-doumbouya-la-future-star-du-basket-francais-est-revenu-fleury-les-aubrais-pour-les-fetes-1483192577 |publisher=[[France Bleu]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=31 December 2016}} By age 13, when Doumbouya stood {{height|m=2.02}}, he was playing youth basketball with his local club CJF Les Aubrais, the basketball sports section of Collège Condorcet.{{cite web |title=2,02 mètres, 13 ans, graine de champion |url=https://www.lechorepublicain.fr/mainvilliers/vie-pratique-consommation/2014/06/26/2-02-metres-13-ans-graine-de-champion_11057711.html |website=L'Écho républicain| language = fr| access-date=18 August 2018 |date=26 June 2014}} In May 2016, Doumbouya represented French sports institute [[INSEP]] at the under-18 [[2015–16 Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|2015–16 Adidas Next Generation Tournament]], averaging 14 points, 3.7 rebounds, and three assists while being one of the youngest players at the event at age 16.{{cite web |title=Doumbouya, Sekou |url=http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=006834&seasoncode=JTF415#!JTF415_TO |publisher=[[EuroLeague]] |access-date=18 August 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Makris |first1=Stefanos |title=Adidas Next Generation Tournament: Top Prospects |url=http://www.nbadraft.net/adidas-next-generation-tournament-top-prospects |publisher=NBADraft |access-date=18 August 2018 |date=22 May 2016}} After the season, he was dismissed from INSEP for disciplinary reasons.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya est français |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Sekou-doumbouya-est-francais/745601 |website=[[L'Équipe]] |access-date=18 August 2018 |language=fr |date=3 November 2016}} ==Professional career== === Centre Fédéral (2015–2016) === At age 14, Doumbouya moved to the renowned French sports institute [[INSEP]] in [[Paris]] and joined its affiliated club [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]], a member of the [[Nationale Masculine 1]] (NM1), the amateur [[French basketball league system|third-tier division]] of French basketball.{{cite web |last1=Colombani |first1=Xavier |date=13 October 2016 |title=Sekou Doumbouya, un "diamant brut" se cache en Pro B |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Article/Sekou-doumbouya-un-diamant-brut-se-cache-en-pro-b/732332 |access-date=18 August 2018 |website=[[L'Équipe]] |language=fr}} He made his 2015–16 season debut on 26 September 2015, recording 12 points, five rebounds, and three steals against Aurore de Vitré.{{cite web |date=26 September 2015 |title=Sep 26, 2015 – Aurore de Vitre 99, Centre Federal Du Basket-Ball 60 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2015-09-26/Aurore-de-Vitre-at-Centre-Federal-Du-Basket-Ball/215933 |access-date=18 August 2018 |publisher=[[RealGM]]}} In turn, Doumbouya became the first player born in the 2000s to play in the top three French leagues.{{cite web |last1=Bellot |first1=François |date=12 December 2016 |title=Il n'a pas fini de grandir |url=https://www.lanouvellerepublique.fr/poitiers/il-n-a-pas-fini-de-grandir |access-date=18 August 2018 |website=La Nouvelle République |language=fr}} On 8 March 2016, he scored a season-high 23 points in a loss to [[Vendée Challans Basket|Vendée Challans]].{{cite web |date=8 March 2016 |title=March 8, 2016 – Vendee Challans Basket 92, Centre Federal Du Basket-Ball 64 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2016-03-08/Vendee-Challans-Basket-at-Centre-Federal-Du-Basket-Ball/216793 |access-date=18 August 2018 |publisher=[[RealGM]]}} Doumbouya finished the season averaging 10.6 points, 3.3 rebounds, 1.2 assists, and 1.4 steals per game.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya Player Profile |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Sekou-Doumbouya/Summary/98052 |access-date=18 August 2018 |publisher=[[RealGM]]}} ===Poitiers Basket 86 (2016–2018)=== [[File:Sekou Doumbouya (cropped).jpg|thumb|Doumbouya with [[Poitiers Basket 86|Poitiers]] in March 2017]] On 26 August 2016, at age 15, Doumbouya signed his first professional contract with [[Poitiers Basket 86]] of the [[LNB Pro B]], the second-tier French league.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13284/sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |access-date=20 August 2018 |language=fr |date=26 August 2016 |archive-date=21 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180821093843/https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13284/sekou-doumbouya |url-status=dead }} At the time, he revealed his hopes to play in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) within the following three years. In the season, Doumbouya saw regular playing time despite his lack of experience, being coached by Ruddy Nelhomme and playing alongside veterans like [[:fr:Jeff Greer|Jeff Greer]].{{cite web |last1=Legendre |first1=Pascal |title=Sekou Doumbouya (Poitiers), 15 ans en Pro B, et il joue ! |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/381510/sekou-doumbouya-poitiers-15-ans-en-pro-b-et-il-joue/ |publisher=BasketEurope |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=15 October 2016}}{{cite web |title=Portrait Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13348/portrait-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=17 November 2016 |archive-date=22 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180822081047/https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13348/portrait-sekou-doumbouya |url-status=dead }} While with Poitiers, he attended [[private school]] to work towards his diploma, and tried to model the focus he saw in former NBA player [[Michael Jordan]] with the help of a [[sports psychology|sports psychologist]]. On 17 September 2016, Doumbouya made his professional debut, playing 13 minutes in an [[LNB Pro B Leaders Cup]] victory over [[Boulazac Basket Dordogne|Boulazac]].{{cite web |title=Boulazac – Poitiers |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/prob/match/boulazac-poitiers-12138.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |date=17 September 2016}} In his first Pro B season game on 14 October 2016, he scored two points in six minutes off the bench against [[Étoile Charleville-Mézières]].{{cite web |title=Oct 14, 2016 – Poitiers Basket 86 69, Etoile Charleville-Mezieres 79 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2016-10-14/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Etoile-Charleville-Mezieres/240826 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=20 August 2018 |date=14 October 2016}} He scored double figures for the first time on 20 January 2017, in an 81–63 loss to [[Fos Provence Basket|Fos Provence]], posting a team-high 16 points on 7-of-11 shooting.{{cite web |title=Jan 20, 2017 – Poitiers Basket 86 63, Fos Ouest Provence Basket 81 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-01-20/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Fos-Ouest-Provence-Basket/241631 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=20 August 2018 |date=20 January 2017}} In his next game, a defeat to [[Lille Métropole BC|Lille Métropole]], Doumbouya scored a season-high 21 points and nine rebounds, shooting 3-of-3 from the three-point line.{{cite web |title=Jan 24, 2017 – Lille Metropole Basket Clubs 71, Poitiers Basket 86 70 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-01-24/Lille-Metropole-Basket-Clubs-at-Poitiers-Basket-86/241642 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=20 August 2018 |date=24 January 2017}} He finished the season averaging 6.8 points, 3.3 rebounds, and 0.8 assists in 16.9 minutes per game. Doumbouya, on 29 June 2017, signed a three-year contract extension with Poitiers.{{cite web |last1=Camacho |first1=Cyril |title=Sékou Doumbouya à Poitiers jusqu'en 2020 |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/401394/sekou-doumbouya-a-poitiers-jusquen-2020/ |publisher=BasketEurope |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=29 June 2017}} On 29 September, he notched a [[double (basketball)|double-double]] of 15 points and 12 rebounds in a 76–71 win over [[Hermine Nantes Basket|Hermine Nantes]] at the LNB Pro B Leaders Cup.{{cite web |title=Poitiers – Nantes |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/prob/match/poitiers-nantes-7881.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=29 September 2017}} Doumbouya debuted in the [[2017–18 Pro B season]] against [[Denain Voltaire Basket|Denain Voltaire]] on 13 October 2017, recording seven points and four rebounds in 16 minutes.{{cite web |title=Oct 13, 2017 – Poitiers Basket 86 82, Denain ASC Voltaire 91 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-10-13/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Denain-ASC-Voltaire/273863 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |date=13 October 2017}} On 22 December, he scored a season-best 19 points and eight rebounds in a loss to [[Saint-Chamond Basket|Saint-Chamond]].{{cite web |title=Dec 22, 2017 – Saint Chamond Basket 93, Poitiers Basket 86 91 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-12-22/Saint-Chamond-Basket-at-Poitiers-Basket-86/274470 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |date=22 December 2017}} Doumbouya eclipsed that mark on 2 February 2018, in a career-high 26-point effort against [[UJAP Quimper 29]].{{cite web |title=Feb 2, 2018 – Quimper UJAP 84, Poitiers Basket 86 76 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2018-02-02/Quimper-UJAP-at-Poitiers-Basket-86/274656 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |date=2 February 2018}} In 28 games, he averaged 8.5 points, 4.1 rebounds, and one assist in 23.2 minutes per game, en route to earning Pro B Best Young Player honors.{{cite web |title=Sekou élu meilleur jeune de Pro B |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13718/sekou-elu-meilleur-jeune-de-prob |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=17 May 2018 |archive-date=22 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180822050013/https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13718/sekou-elu-meilleur-jeune-de-prob |url-status=dead }} ===Limoges CSP (2018–2019)=== [[File:Sekou Doumbouya 2 (cropped) (2).jpg|thumb|left|Doumbouya with [[Limoges CSP]] in September 2018]] In May 2018, Doumbouya revealed plans to join a team in the [[LNB Pro A]], the top basketball league in France.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya confirme qu'il y a quatre clubs dans sa short-list |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/sekou-doumbouya-confirme-qu-il-y-a-quatre-clubs-dans-sa-short-list.html |publisher=BeBasket |access-date=21 August 2018 |language=fr |date=29 May 2018 |archive-date=22 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180822050201/https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/sekou-doumbouya-confirme-qu-il-y-a-quatre-clubs-dans-sa-short-list.html |url-status=dead }} On 25 June 2018, he signed with [[Limoges CSP]] of the Pro A.{{cite web |title=L'espoir du basket français, Sekou Doumbouya rejoint le Limoges CSP |url=https://www.limogescsp.com/news/20180625055314-lespoir-du-basket-francais-sekou-doumbouya-rejoint-le-limoges-csp |publisher=[[Limoges CSP]] |access-date=25 June 2018 |language=fr |date=25 June 2018}} Head coach Kyle Milling praised the newcomer: "Despite his age, next season, I rely on him being an impact player. He has tremendous physical qualities: running, counterattack and speed."{{cite web |title=Limoges signs young prospect Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/701573/limoges-signs-sekou-doumbouya/ |publisher=EuroHoops |access-date=25 June 2018 |date=25 June 2018}} Doumbouya debuted for Limoges on 22 September 2018, recording two points and four rebounds in 11 minutes against [[Olympique Antibes|Antibes]].{{cite web |title=Antibes – Limoges |url=https://www.lnb.fr/en/proa/match/antibes-limoges-201612597.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |access-date=22 September 2018 |language=fr |date=22 September 2018 |archive-date=23 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180923005814/https://www.lnb.fr/en/proa/match/antibes-limoges-201612597.html#stats |url-status=dead }} On 17 October, he scored 11 points, shooting 4-of-6 from the field, in a 102–93 loss to [[Alba Berlin]] in the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{cite web |title=Oct 17, 2018 – ALBA Berlin 102, CSP Limoges 93 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2018-10-17/ALBA-Berlin-at-CSP-Limoges/311495 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=20 October 2018 |date=17 October 2018}} In late December, Doumbouya scored 12 points in three straight games in the EuroCup and Pro A, shooting a combined 14-of-17 from the field.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya Game Logs |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Sekou-Doumbouya/GameLogs/98052 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=29 December 2018}} On 26 December, he suffered a right thumb injury that required surgery.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya out 5 to 7 weeks |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/800058/sekou-doumbouya-out-5-to-7-weeks/ |publisher=EuroHoops |access-date=29 December 2018 |date=26 December 2018}} Doumbouya returned to action on 9 February, scoring nine points and grabbing five rebounds versus [[SIG Basket|Strasbourg]].{{cite web |last1=Pante-Jouve |first1=Gabriel |title=Limoges: Doumbouya de retour contre Strasbourg ce samedi? |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/limoges---doumbouya-de-retour-contre-strasbourg-ce-samedi--.html |publisher=BeBasket |access-date=27 April 2019 |language=fr |date=4 February 2019 |archive-date=3 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191203224134/https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/limoges---doumbouya-de-retour-contre-strasbourg-ce-samedi--.html |url-status=dead }} On 9 March, he recorded a season-high 14 points, five rebounds, and two blocks in an 85–73 loss to [[AS Monaco Basket|Monaco]].{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya has career high in loss for Limoges |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/proa/841713/sekou-doumbouya-has-career-high-in-loss-for-limoges/ |publisher=EuroHoops |access-date=27 April 2019 |date=9 March 2019}} Doumbouya erupted for a career-high 34 points, with five three-pointers and nine rebounds, on 18 May, in a 106–78 regular season finale win over [[Levallois Metropolitans]].{{cite web |title=May 18, 2019 – Paris-Levallois Basket 78 at CSP Limoges 106 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2019-05-18/Paris-Levallois-Basket-at-CSP-Limoges/333491 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=18 May 2019 |date=18 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Rutard |first1=Sacha |title=Record personnels de 34 points et de 37 d'évaluation pour Sekou Doumbouya (Limoges) |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/lnb/459599/record-personnels-de-34-points-et-de-37-devaluation-pour-sekou-doumbouya-limoges/ |publisher=BasketEurope |access-date=18 May 2019 |language=fr |date=18 May 2019}} In 29 Pro A games, including two playoff contests, he averaged 7.7 points and 3.2 rebounds per game. In eight EuroCup appearances, Doumbouya averaged 6.9 points and 2.8 rebounds per game. ===Detroit Pistons (2019–2021)=== [[File:Sekou Doumbouya layup (cropped).jpg|thumb|Doumbouya (#45) attempts a [[layup]] for the [[Grand Rapids Drive]] in 2019.]] On 20 June 2019, Doumbouya was selected by the [[Detroit Pistons]] with the fifteenth pick in the [[2019 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Beard |first1=Rod |title='A kid with big upside': Pistons select Sekou Doumbouya with 15th pick |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2019/06/20/pistons-select-sekou-doumbouya-15th-pick/1509507001/ |website=[[The Detroit News]] |access-date=21 June 2019 |date=20 June 2019}} He became the first player born in Guinea to be drafted into the NBA. On 4 July, he signed his rookie contract with the Pistons.{{cite web |last1=Khan |first1=Ansar |title=Pistons sign top pick Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.mlive.com/pistons/2019/07/pistons-sign-top-pick-sekou-doumbouya.html |publisher=MLive |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=4 July 2019}} Doumbouya missed his team's first four games at the [[2019 NBA Summer League#Las Vegas Summer League|2019 Las Vegas NBA Summer League]] with hamstring pain and scored nine points in his only appearance, during a 105–85 loss to the [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web |last1=Langlois |first1=Keith |title=Other than Sekou's minor setback, Pistons had a smashing stay in Las Vegas |url=https://www.nba.com/pistons/features/other-sekous-minor-setback-pistons-had-smashing-stay-las-vegas |publisher=[[National Basketball Association]] |access-date=22 June 2020 |date=16 July 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Beard |first1=Rod |title=Doumbouya makes most of his minutes in Pistons' Summer League finale |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2019/07/13/pistons-summer-league-run-ends-20-point-pummeling-nets/1727350001/ |website=[[The Detroit News]] |access-date=22 June 2020 |date=13 July 2019}} In his rookie season, he was the [[List of oldest and youngest National Basketball Association players|youngest active player in the NBA]].{{cite web |last1=Sankofa II |first1=Omari |title=Detroit Pistons rookie Sekou Doumbouya teased us with a glimpse of the tools to be special |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2020/05/29/detroit-pistons-sekou-doumbouya-rebuild/5278115002/ |website=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=24 June 2020 |date=29 May 2020}} He suffered a [[concussion]] during practice on 9 October and was sidelined for multiple games after being placed into the concussion protocol program.{{cite web |last1=Taylor |first1=Cody |title=Concussion protocol has delayed the debut of Pistons' Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2019/10/25/detroit-pistons-sekou-doumbouya-concussion-protocol-nba-debut-injury/ |publisher=Rookie Wire |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=25 October 2019}} On 4 November, before playing an NBA game, Doumbouya was assigned to the Pistons' [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Grand Rapids Drive]].{{cite web |last1=Wallner |first1=Peter J. |title=Sekou Doumbouya heads to Grand Rapids Drive |url=https://www.mlive.com/pistons/2019/11/sekou-doumbouya-heads-to-grand-rapids-drive.html |publisher=MLive |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=4 November 2019}} He made his G League debut four days later, scoring 12 points in a 109–94 win over [[Raptors 905]].{{cite web |title=Nov 8, 2019 - Grand Rapids Drive 109 at Raptors 905 94 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/boxscore/2019-11-08/Grand-Rapids-at-Raptors/341945 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=8 November 2019}} On 23 November 2019, Doumbouya was recalled by the Pistons and made his NBA debut in a 104–90 loss to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web |last1=Khan |first1=Ansar |title=Pistons' Sekou Doumbouya poised for NBA debut after recall |url=https://www.mlive.com/pistons/2019/11/pistons-sekou-doumbouya-poised-for-nba-debut-after-recall.html |publisher=MLive |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=23 November 2019}} In early January 2020, he registered double-doubles in each of his first two starts against the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] and the [[Golden State Warriors]].{{cite web |last1=Ellis |first1=Vince |title=Detroit Pistons' Sekou Doumbouya nets 2nd double-double in win vs. Warriors, 111-104 |url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2020/01/04/detroit-pistons-golden-state-warriors-score/2814264001/ |website=[[Detroit Free Press]] |access-date=23 June 2020 |date=4 January 2020}} On 15 January, Doumbouya scored a season-high 24 points with two rebounds, an assist and a steal in a 116–103 victory over the [[Boston Celtics]].{{cite web|title=Sekou Doumbouya scores 24, Pistons down Celtics 116-103|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401161246|date=15 January 2020|website=[[ESPN]]|access-date=15 January 2020}} His production declined after the performance, and he scored at least 10 points in one more NBA game for the rest of the season. On 6 March, Doumbouya was assigned to the G League, recording 30 points and eight rebounds and making a game-winning jump shot in a 102–101 win over the [[Maine Red Claws]].{{cite web |last1=Beard |first1=Rod |title=Sekou Doumbouya showing signs that Pistons made the right pick |url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2020/03/08/beard-sekou-doumbouya-showing-signs-detroit-pistons-made-right-pick/4994482002/ |website=[[The Detroit News]] |access-date=24 June 2020 |date=8 March 2020}} In the [[2019–20 NBA season]], he averaged 6.4 points and 3.1 rebounds in 19.8 minutes per game, starting in 19 of his 38 appearances.{{cite web |last1=Kasabian |first1=Paul |title=Pistons' Sekou Doumbouya Home with Family in France Amid COVID-19 |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2887353-pistons-sekou-doumbouya-home-with-family-in-france-amid-covid-19 |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |access-date=24 June 2020 |date=18 April 2020}} ===Los Angeles Lakers (2021–2022)=== On 4 September 2021, Doumbouya and [[Jahlil Okafor]] were traded to the [[Brooklyn Nets]] in exchange for [[DeAndre Jordan]] and multiple second-round draft picks.{{cite web |title=Brooklyn Nets Complete Trade With Detroit Pistons |url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2021/09/04/brooklyn-nets-complete-trade-detroit-pistons |website=NBA.com |access-date=5 September 2021 |date=4 September 2021}} On 6 October, Doumbouya was again traded, alongside a 2024 second-round pick, to the [[Houston Rockets]] in exchange for cash considerations.{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Complete Trade With Houston Rockets|url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/2021/10/06/brooklyn-nets-complete-trade-houston-rockets|website=NBA.com|date=6 October 2021|access-date=6 October 2021}} He was waived the following day.{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Rockets Waive Sekou Doumbouya|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/rockets-waive-sekou-doumbouya.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=7 October 2021|access-date=8 October 2021}} On 12 October, the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] signed Doumbouya to a two-way contract with the [[South Bay Lakers]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{Cite web|title=Lakers Sign Sekou Doumbouya to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/lakers-sign-sekou-doumbouya-to-two-way-contract-2021|website=NBA.com|date=12 October 2021|access-date=12 October 2021}} On 16 November, Doumbouya was waived by the Lakers, after appearing in two games, to make room for [[Chaundee Brown]].{{cite web|title=Lakers Sign Chaundee Brown Jr. to Two-Way Contract; Waive Sekou Doumbouya|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/lakers-sign-chaundee-brown-jr-to-two-way-contract-waive-sekou-doumbouya-2021|website=NBA.com|date=16 November 2021|access-date=17 November 2021}} On 12 January 2022, the Lakers re-signed Doumbouya to a two-way contract.{{Cite web|title=Lakers Sign Sekou Doumbouya to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/lakers-sign-sekou-doumbouya-two-way-contract-waive-jay-huff-1-12-22|access-date=January 12, 2022|website=NBA}} However, before appearing in a game during his second stint with the team, he was waived on 1 March.{{Cite web |title=Lakers Sign D.J. Augustin and Wenyen Gabriel |url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/lakers-sign-dj-augustin-wenyen-gabriel-3-1-22 |access-date=March 1, 2022 |website=NBA}} ===Delaware Blue Coats (2022–2023)=== On November 4, 2022, Doumbouya was named to the opening night roster for the [[Delaware Blue Coats]],{{cite web|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/blue-coats-announce-opening-night-roster/n-5895485|title=Blue Coats Announce Opening Night Roster|website=oursportscentral.com|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 3, 2022}} and eventually helped the team win the [[NBA G League]] title.{{cite web|first=Noah|last=Levick|title=Delaware Blue Coats win G League championship; Jaden Springer named Finals MVP|url=https://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/sixers/delaware-blue-coats-nba-g-league-championship-2023-jaden-springer-mac-mcclung|website=NBCSports.com|date=April 7, 2023|access-date=April 7, 2023}} ===Chorale Roanne Basket (2024)=== On 23 February 2024, Doumbouya signed with [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].{{cite web|first=Fabien|last=Zaghini|title=Sekou Doumbouya choralien jusqu'à la fin de la saison|url=https://www.chorale-roanne.com/sekou-doumbouya-choralien-jusqua-la-fin-de-la-saison/|website=Chorale-Roanne.com|date=23 February 2024|access-date=23 February 2024|language=fr}} ===MoraBanc Andorra (2024–2025)=== On July 14, 2024, he signed with [[BC Andorra|MoraBanc Andorra]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/morabanc-andorra-official-signing-of-sekou-doumbouya/|title=MoraBanc Andorra: official signing of Sekou Doumbouya|last=|first=|date=July 14, 2024|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=July 15, 2024}} ===Sagesse Club (2025)=== On May 29, 2025, he signed with [[Sagesse SC (basketball)|Sagesse Club]] of the [[Lebanese Basketball League]] (LBL).{{Cite Instagram |user=sagesseclubofcl |postid=DKPzCPVoAY2 |title=Sekou Doumbouya is officially part of the squad |date=May 29, 2025}} ==National team career== In November 2016, Doumbouya obtained French citizenship. The process was delayed by months due to "bureaucracy," according to the [[France national under-19 basketball team|France national under-18 team]], and as a result he was barred from two [[FIBA]] competitions. Doumbouya made his national team debut at the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] in [[Samsun]], Turkey, which he entered as its youngest player.{{cite web |title=Ntilikina, Tchouaffe, youngster Doumbouya headline France outfit |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/ntilikina-tchouaffe-youngster-doumbouya-headline-france-outfit |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=6 December 2016}}{{cite web |last1=Makris |first1=Stefanos |title=U18 European Championship: Top Prospects |url=http://www.nbadraft.net/u18-european-championship-top-prospects |publisher=NBADraft |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=29 December 2016}} In his first game at the tournament, a 53–48 win over [[Russia national under-19 basketball team|Russia]], he scored seven points and grabbed a team-high 10 rebounds.{{cite web |title=Dec 16, 2016 – Russia 48, France 53 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-12-16/Russia-at-France/239294 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=16 December 2016}} In his next contest, Doumbouya led all scorers with 22 points and six rebounds against [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenia]].{{cite web |last1=De Abreu |first1=Dylan |title=Euro U18: la France explose la Slovénie |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/386411/euro-u18-la-france-explose-la-slovenie/ |publisher=BasketEurope |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=17 December 2016}} In his third game, he erupted for 31 points, shooting 10-of-11 from the field, to lead France past [[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Serbia]], 71–68.{{cite web |title=Dec 18, 2016 – Serbia 68, France 71 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-12-18/Serbia-at-France/258942 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=18 December 2016}} Doumbouya averaged a team-best 17.8 points, seven rebounds, 1.3 steals, and 1.2 blocks at the tournament, helping his team win the [[gold medal]]. He was named to the All-Star Five, joined by teammate and tournament most valuable player [[Frank Ntilikina]].{{cite web |title=MVP Ntilikina headlines All-Star Five of FIBA U18 European Championship |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/mvp-ntilikina-headlines-all-star-five |publisher=[[FIBA]] |access-date=22 August 2018 |date=22 December 2016}} ==Player profile== Listed at {{height|m=2.03}} and {{convert|104|kg|lb|abbr=on}}, Doumbouya is primarily a [[small forward]] but is capable of playing the [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position due to his size and length,{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=French teen Doumbouya declares for NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/26558707/french-teen-doumbouya-declares-nba-draft |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=19 April 2019}} standing 2.05 m (6 ft 8 {{3/4}} in) with a [[wingspan]] of {{height|m=2.11}}.{{cite web |title=Doumbouya Sekou |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/proa/joueurs/doumbouya-sekou-A68566.html |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |language=fr}}{{cite web |last1=Daniels |first1=Evan |last2=Gershon |first2=Josh |title=Who stood out at Basketball Without Borders? |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Basketball-Without-Borders-Which-prospects-helped-their-stock-at-the-prestigious-international-event-115389652/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |access-date=19 August 2018 |date=22 February 2018}} He displays fluid athleticism that helps him thrive in transition and finish at the rim.{{cite web |last1=Crabbe |first1=Kyle |title=NBA Draft: Best team fit for each of the top 10 prospects |url=https://sircharlesincharge.com/2019/05/15/nba-draft-best-fit-prospects-zion/9/ |publisher=Sir Charles In Charge |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=15 May 2019}} His physical tools gave him great potential in the modern NBA, especially on the defensive end, where he is able to defend four positions.{{cite web |last1=Chang |first1=Anthony |title=What to know about draft prospect Sekou Doumbouya. What if he's there for Heat at 13? |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article230636579.html |website=[[Miami Herald]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=21 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Goul |first1=Matt |title=Sekou Doumbouya NBA Draft 2019 profile: Stats, bio, video of the international forward |url=https://www.cleveland.com/cavs/2019/04/sekou-doumbouya-nba-draft-2019-profile-stats-bio-video-of-the-international-forward.html |website=[[The Plain Dealer]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=19 April 2019}} Doumbouya also had potential as a shooter, with evaluators often praising his mechanics, and as a playmaker.{{cite web |last1=Hughes |first1=Chase |title=2019 NBA Draft prospect profile: Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/washington/wizards/2019-nba-draft-prospect-profile-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[NBC Sports]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=28 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Strobl |first1=Pete |title=Scouting report: Get to know draft prospect Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://hoopshype.com/2019/03/31/scouting-report-get-to-know-draft-prospect-sekou-doumbouya/ |publisher=HoopsHype |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=31 March 2019}} His playing style has drawn comparisons to NBA players [[Pascal Siakam]] and [[Draymond Green]].{{cite web |last1=Rand |first1=Michael |title=A French Siakam and the Wolves? |url=https://www.startribune.com/a-french-siakam-and-the-wolves/510742622/ |website=[[Star Tribune]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=2 June 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Cohen |first1=Josh |title=2019 Draft Prospects: Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.nba.com/magic/2019-draft-prospects-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Orlando Magic]] |access-date=7 June 2019 |date=1 May 2019}} Vincent Loriot, sports director for French club [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket|Le Mans]], likened Doumbouya to NBA player [[LeBron James]], calling him "a monster with a child's face". ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"|{{nbay|2019}} | style="text-align:left;"|[[2019–20 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit]] | 38 || '''19''' || '''19.8''' || .390 || .286 || .674 || '''3.1''' || '''.5''' || .5 || .2 || 6.4 |- | style="text-align:left;"|{{nbay|2020}} | style="text-align:left;"|[[2020–21 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit]] | '''56''' || 11 || 15.5 || .379 || .226 || .703 || 2.6 || '''.8''' || .4 || .2 || 5.1 |- | style="text-align:left;"|{{nbay|2021}} | style="text-align:left;"|[[2021–22 Los Angeles Lakers season|L.A.
